data.name: Havoc Arena
data.detailed_description:
Havoc Arena is a fast-paced multiplayer action game set in a stylized ancient desert world filled with pyramids, forgotten monuments, and powerful magic. Enter the arena alone or with friends and battle other players or AI enemies using melee weapons, destructive spells, and dynamic physics-based combat.

Fight across shifting sands where skill, timing, and strategy determine who becomes the true Lord of the arena.

Whether you prefer chaotic PvP battles, cooperative matches against bots, or solo play, Havoc Arena offers quick, action-packed matches designed for competitive and casual players alike.

Fast-Paced Arena Combat

Jump into intense battles where close combat, ranged attacks, and magic abilities combine to create unpredictable fights. Master different weapons, react quickly, and use the environment to gain the upper hand.

Multiple Game Modes

Havoc Arena is designed around short, action-packed matches with multiple modes.

Available at launch:

  • Free For All (FFA)

  • Team Deathmatch

Planned modes:

  • Battle Royale

  • Capture Zone

  • Domination

Each mode offers a different style of combat and strategic gameplay.

Play Your Way

Choose how you want to fight in the arena:

  • Multiplayer PvP – compete against other players online

  • Co-op PvE – team up with friends and fight bots

  • Singleplayer – practice and battle AI opponents

Magic and Weapons

Use a combination of weapons and magical abilities to defeat your enemies.

  • Melee weapons for brutal close combat

  • Ranged attacks for distance fighting

  • Powerful magic spells to control the battlefield

  • Physics-driven interactions that create chaotic and dynamic fights

Stylized Ancient World

Explore arenas inspired by ancient desert civilizations, featuring pyramids, buildings and mystical environments brought to life with a stylized visual design.

Early Development

Havoc Arena is currently in active development with plans to expand content over time. New maps, game modes, abilities, and gameplay features will be added as development continues.

data.short_description: Become a Lord of the restless ancient sands. Equip powerful weapons to unleash havoc across the dunes in both ranged and close combat. Choose your path of destruction by casting devastating spells and bending magic to your will.

English*, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian
*languages with full audio support
